agent3 (invoice) API proposal. Reply only if you object or want changes; otherwise please implement exactly this.
pricing.py (agent1):
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  get_unit_price(sku) -> Decimal dollars; returns Decimal('0') if sku unknown (call has_sku first)
  get_customer_discount(customer_id) -> Decimal multiplier, e.g. Decimal('0.90') for 10% off; returns Decimal('1') if customer unknown
  has_customer(customer_id) -> bool
tax.py (agent2):
  get_tax_multiplier(customer_id) -> Decimal, e.g. Decimal('1.0825') for 8.25%; returns Decimal('1') if unknown (0% tax)
  compute_tax(customer_id, lines) -> Decimal tax amount in dollars, rounded to cent. lines = list of (sku, net_amount Decimal) for known SKUs, net_amount = line amount AFTER customer discount (unrounded not needed; I quantize to cents). You decide which lines are taxable and the rule.
  Note: the spec example (tax 1.86 at 8.25%) only works if the taxable base is 22.50 = A line after 10% discount, i.e. D (14.10 -> 12.69) is NOT taxable under this customer's rules. So please make sure compute_tax applies per-SKU taxability.
Money: Decimal dollars, quantized to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_UP. Unknown customer -> name shown is the id, discount 0%, tax 0%.

agent2 (tax): proposed tax API. tax.compute_tax_cents(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents. lines = [(category, amount_cents), ...] pre-discount line amounts (category is exact string, e.g. 'food'). region = customer region string (key in rates.csv, e.g. 'TX'), or None for an unknown customer (0 tax). discount_pct = customer discount percent 0-100 (default 0). Returns integer cents, half-up rounded. Unknown non-None region raises KeyError. Please have pricing supply region/discount_pct and invoice just call this; invoice must not compute tax rules. Reply accept/object or propose changes.

agent1 (pricing) API is implemented in pricing.py. Money = float dollars, discount = fraction, misses return None. Functions: get_item(sku) -> Item|None with fields sku, name, price (dollars), category. get_customer(customer_id) -> Customer|None with fields id, name, discount (fraction, e.g. 0.10), region (string such as 'TX', passed through unchanged for tax.py). Also list_items() and list_customers(). Please call these from invoice.py; tax.py should take the region string from Customer.region and return a fraction. Tell me if you want a different shape.

agent3 (invoice): I withdraw my earlier proposal. Accepting the existing APIs: agent1's pricing.py as implemented (get_item -> Item(sku,name,price,category) or None; get_customer -> Customer(id,name,discount fraction,region) or None). Accepting agent2's tax.compute_tax_cents(lines, region, discount_pct=0) -> int cents, with lines=[(category, amount_cents)] pre-discount and discount_pct as 0-100. invoice.py will convert at the boundary: price float dollars -> integer cents (ROUND_HALF_UP), discount fraction -> percent (x100), and call compute_tax_cents with region=None for unknown customers. Tax % shown will come from a tax-percent value; agent2: please tell me the function that returns the rate for display (e.g. tax.get_rate_percent(region) -> Decimal or int basis points), otherwise I will derive it by calling compute_tax_cents on 10000 cents with discount 0 (which gives the rate in cents per 100 dollars) — tell me if you prefer otherwise.

agent3 (invoice): invoice.py is implemented in my repo. It uses pricing.get_item / pricing.get_customer (agent1's current API) and tax.compute_tax_cents(lines, region, discount_pct=float 0-100) (agent2's proposal). It also needs ONE more function from tax.py for the displayed rate: tax.get_rate_percent(region) -> Decimal percent (e.g. Decimal('8.25')), called only for known customers. agent2: please add it, or tell me the name you want and I will change one line. Tested against stubs: the spec example matches byte-for-byte. Unknown customer shows id, 0%, $0.00 tax (region None, no tax call for rate).
